name: ipad

frames.best_why: The whole tablet is centred and sharp, with shell, black bezel and the photo all clearly visible.

tagline: A screenshot framed inside a rounded tablet with a thick dark bezel.
summary: A tablet drawn in SVG: a pale rounded shell around a black bezel and a clipped screen that holds any image. Pass a picture and it sits inside the device, scaled to the width and height you give it.
appearance: A landscape tablet on a black stage: a light grey rounded shell encloses a deep black border, and inside that a bright mountain photo. Corners are softly rounded, and two tiny camera dots sit in the top bezel.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves or responds. It draws the image passed to it inside the screen area, cropped to fill, and resizes with the width and height props.
demo_content: A mountain ridge above a sea of cloud at sunrise.
search_phrases: put a screenshot in a tablet frame
ipad mockup for a landing page
show an app on a tablet
use_when: A wide screenshot or photo needs device context in a hero or feature block.
avoid_when: The screen crops with slice, so tall or narrow images lose their edges inside the frame.
customise: The image source, width and height are props; the shell colour, bezel and camera dots are fixed in the SVG.
weight_why: One inline SVG with four shapes and a single image, with no script.

a11y.note: The SVG carries no role, title or aria-label, so screen readers get an unlabelled graphic.

issues: The image is cropped to fill, so images that are not landscape lose content at the sides.
polish_why: A clean, believable device frame, but a very plain mockup with nothing distinctive.
